Why exponentials fool us

Put one grain of rice on the first square and double it on every square after.
Square 1
1 grain
Square 32
≈ 2 billion grains
Square 64

From square 33 on, every square holds more than the entire first half combined. That is where AI is now.

5
1965
The idea · 1965
“…the first ultraintelligent machine is the last invention that man need ever make…”
I. J. Good, mathematician and Bletchley Park codebreaker, who called it an intelligence explosion: machines smart enough to design better machines. He added a condition: only if we can keep them under control.
AI is now accelerating AI
The loop, 2026
AI agents do research work
Experiments run faster
Better models ship sooner
Better models build better agents
Each turn runs faster
September 2026
OpenAI reports reaching its “automated research intern” goal: AI that carries out well-defined research tasks that would take a skilled researcher a few days.
3.1 to 1
Agent-workdays for every human workday inside OpenAI’s research teams by mid-August 2026.
March 2028
OpenAI’s stated target for a true automated AI researcher.
Sources: OpenAI, “Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI” (Sept 2026); eWeek (Sept 2026); TechCrunch (Oct 2025).

Where the days go
Anatomy of a loan file
37–42 days
Average time to close a purchase loan: 42 days across 2025, about 37 days in spring 2026.
Almost every step is information work: requesting, reading, verifying, chasing and waiting.
Application
collect · read
Disclosures
send · track · confirm
Documents & VOEs
request · chase · verify
Appraisal
order · track · review
Title & insurance
request · chase · match
Condo / HOA
questionnaire · budget · review
Underwriting
review · clear · resubmit
Clear to close
check · schedule · sign
Source: ICE Mortgage Technology, as reported by CNBC Select, Zillow and Tomo (2025–2026).

The great divergence
Bolted on vs. built around
Bolted on: AI is a tool in a browser tab. People still carry the file.
Built around: AI is the operating system. Every file makes the next one faster.

21
The division of labor
Who does what
AI agents
  • Read every page, instantly
  • Request and chase every document
  • Verify income, assets and employment
  • Track every third party and deadline
  • Draft updates for clients and agents
  • Answer routine questions at 2 a.m.
Our people
  • Understand what the family is really after
  • Structure the hard files
  • Advise on the biggest purchase of their lives
  • Solve problems with agents, sellers and title
  • Make the judgment calls, and own them
  • Stay in their life long after closing
AI handles the paperwork. We handle the people.
Our projection, not a promise
The next decade, as we see it
2026
Copilots on every file
Agents read documents, chase conditions and keep clients updated. People approve every step.
2027
The autonomous processor
Agents run the conditions loop end to end. People handle exceptions, advice and approvals.
2028
Agent meets agent
Borrowers’ AI agents apply, upload and answer for them. Our agents respond in minutes.
2030
Decisions in minutes
Paperwork stops being the bottleneck. Appraisal, title and the physical world set the pace.
2033
Always-on home finance
AI keeps watch over every past client’s equity, life events and options, all year.
2036
The trusted human at the center
The loan officer becomes each family’s lifelong home-finance advisor, backed by a fleet.
AI-native, not human-free
Guardrails, built in
A licensed human signs off
on every decision that matters to a borrower.
Fair lending by design
The same standards for every borrower, with AI outputs checked for bias.
Data stays protected
Borrower information lives only in approved, secured systems.
Every action traceable
Agent actions are logged, so any step can be explained and audited.
Inside the GSE rules
Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac now require formal AI governance. Our tools are built to fit inside it.
Trust is the product.
Sources: Freddie Mac Guide, AI/ML governance (eff. Mar 2026); Fannie Mae Lender Letter LL-2026-04 (eff. Aug 2026).
